title: erucastrum littoreum subsp. glabrum
intro: Erucastrum littoreum subsp. glabrum, commonly known as glabrous sea rocket, is a plant species in the Brassicaceae family. It is used for its medicinal properties and is a rich source of nutrients, vitamins, and minerals. The glabrous sea rocket plant has been reported to have various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help in the prevention of chronic diseases such as cancer, diabetes, and cardiovascular diseases. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which may exhibit anti-cancer, anti-diabetic, and cardiovascular protective effects.
